data.name: Batvansh
data.gender_notes: Batvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bat' and 'Vansh'. Bat refers to a Lord or God, while Vansh represents lineage or descent from a deity. Thus, Batvansh can be interpreted as 'Descendant of a Lord' or 'Lordly Lineage'. The name Batvansh carries the meaning “Bat - Lord, Vansh - Lineage” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Batvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody bat - lord, vansh - lineage and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of divine blessings and wisdom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Batvansh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: The Battle of Bhut Malik fought in 1191 CE was significant as it marked the beginning of the decline of the Tomar dynasty in Delhi. The victorious Muhammad Ghori, after defeating the Tomars, installed his slave, Qutub-ud-din Aibak as the new ruler of Delhi. This event is known as the 'First Muslim Slave Dynasty' of Delhi. Batvansh is believed to be a branch of the Tomar rulers.
